aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab makes practical software for food trucks and mobile catering: online orders, pickup times and fewer repeated questions. Founder: Dominic Bonini.

aboutPage.story.build: We build practical software specifically for food trucks and mobile caterers, which helps them take online orders, manage pickup times, keep orders running smoothly and spend less time on repeated questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was built to change exactly that.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet most of the software available to them is built with fixed-address businesses in mind.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our aim is simple: make running a food truck easier, with tools built to match how these businesses really work.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab started from a simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their business.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After building Village Foodie — a directory that helps people find food trucks coming to their area — I spent more time learning what difficulties mobile food businesses face. Unlike traditional restaurants, food trucks are constantly on the move, work in different locations and serve customers in changing conditions.

comparison.explained.title: Meaning of the features
comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers see only those pickup times at which your kitchen can really prepare the order. The system calculates from each dish's preparation time and how many you prepare together.
comparison.faq.capacityQ: How does the system prevent too much load on my kitchen?
comparison.faq.costA: {plans}. Online card payments also carry Stripe's fee: {cardFee} per card payment.
comparison.faq.costQ: How much does HatchGrab cost in {country}?
comparison.faq.costTrial: {months, plural, one {The first # month is free with every feature.} other {The first # months are free with every feature.}}
comparison.faq.locationsA: Yes. You make your weekly schedule with places and times, and customers order for the place and the day when you are there.
comparison.faq.locationsQ: Does it work with changing locations?
comparison.faq.paymentsA: Customers pay online with card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or pay at the truck. PayPal and Klarna are not supported at present.
comparison.faq.paymentsQ: Which payment methods does HatchGrab support?
comparison.faq.termA: No. There is neither a minimum term nor a notice period. You can cancel at any time; the fee is taken monthly in advance, and you keep access until the end of the month you have paid for.
comparison.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
comparison.faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not a POS system and has no TSE. How to record online orders in your POS system is a question for your tax adviser.
comparison.faq.tseQ: Do I still need a POS system with a TSE?
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes online orders before customers reach the truck: they choose dishes and a pickup time, pay online or at pickup, and the order shows up in your kitchen. A POS system or card machine takes payment at the truck. The two make up for each other's gaps.

featuresPage.detail.accountant_reports: Sales, tax and refunds for any month, quarter or tax year, ready to download for your accountant.
featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order for an upcoming date or time before the event.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are approved automatically — no need to confirm each one.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Put your logo on your QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Give the order a buzzer number when handing out a buzzer, so you know which buzzer belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen customers can see, showing order numbers and notice of them being ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your truck appears on HatchGrab’s public map, so nearby customers can find you.
featuresPage.detail.documents_reminders: Keep your certificates safe in one place, such as food hygiene, insurance and gas safety. We remind you before anything expires, and you can send them in one tap to an event or market organiser.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your own website. Each date goes straight to its own order page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with prices and settings of your choice for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The most complete way to run HatchGrab: a live kitchen display, and the only way to keep taking orders even when the signal goes.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can cook at one time and how long it takes. Once a slot fills up, customers can’t choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward repeat customers with digital stamp cards — stamps are added and redeemed automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Combine items into deals and offer add-ons at checkout, so the average order grows.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: Like WhatsApp auto-reply, for questions that come in on Messenger and Instagram.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Run several screens — the front counter and the kitchen — all with the same live orders.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff their own logins, with the right level of access.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If the signal goes, online ordering stops, so customers can’t place orders you won’t see. With the iPhone, iPad and Android app you keep taking orders even offline; the web dashboard needs a connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: When customers order online, take card payment upfront via Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: For items that need advance notice, set a cut-off time.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that don’t appear on the map, with their own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.profit_per_event: Enter what each dish costs you and see what you actually earned at each event, not just takings.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule automatically — from your website, or from the photo you already post on Facebook. You just look it over and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Automatically send customers an SMS when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we add your dates, places and times automatically for every week and every event.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item sold out in one tap — it goes dim for customers straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Enter a stock count; it goes down as orders come in, then the item sells out automatically.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a supported phone, so you don’t need a separate card machine.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets on a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a pickup time slot, which spreads the rush across your whole service.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders at the counter, payment on your own card machine.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your service from the browser of any phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: Automatically answer questions that come in on WhatsApp about your menu and schedule.

landing.does.capacityBody: Set how much you can cook at one time, and how long it takes. Once a pickup time fills up, customers can’t choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: On the phone in your apron pocket, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the van — and also on the card machine you already take payment with.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume your address is fixed, wifi is reliable and hours are the same every week. You are somewhere new every week, at different times, with weak or completely absent mobile signal. HatchGrab was built for exactly that.
landing.does.offlineBody: If the signal goes, online ordering stops automatically, so customers can’t place orders you won’t see. Keep taking orders with the iPhone, iPad and Android app.

landing.does.title: Built for food trucks, not for restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What’s there for dessert?” While you’re heading to your spot or standing at the grill, your WhatsApp is answered from your own menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram coming soon.
